items.question: What frequencies of performance are permitted for the prescribed observance?
premises: The observance may be performed one time.
The observance may alternatively be performed two times.
The observance may alternatively be performed three times or a fourth time.

uncertainties: The exact ritual action whose frequency is specified depends on the preceding verses.
